card.name: The word living before organisms
card.fires_on: Mostly the word "living" right before organisms, tissues or cells in biology text. It also fires on "everything" or "something" after "everyone and" or "someone or".

modes.label: Living before organisms
modes.description: The adjective "living" after a preposition or verb, just before words like organisms or tissues.
modes.example: Taxonomists (scientists who classify<< living>> organisms into the seven groups) define

modes.label: Everyone/someone pairs
modes.description: The word "everything" or "something" (or the "or" before it) completing a pair with a person word.
modes.example: It's likely that the law will be abolished before long. used to say that someone or<< something>> will be ready, will be back,
